BrochureContent.Content: Quite simply, one of the most exceptional homes to come to the market in South Dublin in recent years.Hazeldene is a rare combination of an exquisitely designed family residence and truly magnificent wraparound gardens. Extending to approximately 698 sq. meters, this impressive A-rated detached home occupies a wonderfully private position on one of South Dublin's most sought-after roads, where the beauty of the setting rivals that of the house itself. Completely rebuilt in 2009 to the highest standards, Hazeldene showcases the finest craftsmanship, innovative materials, and contemporary design.Approached via granite pillars and electric gates, a sweeping driveway leads through mature grounds, offering a first glimpse of the space, privacy, and tranquillity that define this remarkable property. Set on approximately one acre, the gardens surround the house on all sides, creating a peaceful, leafy sanctuary that feels both secluded and expansive.Inside, the home is designed with family living at its heart, yet perfectly suited to entertaining. A striking double-height entrance hall, flooded with natural light, sets the tone for elegant yet comfortable living. The layout flows effortlessly, with generously proportioned reception rooms providing both formal and informal spaces—ideal for everyday life or hosting larger gatherings.At the centre of the home lies a superb bespoke kitchen and breakfast room, crowned by a stunning octagonal atrium that fills the space with light. Full-width bi-fold doors open onto one of several sun-drenched patios, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. Whether hosting summer gatherings or enjoying quiet family moments, the gardens become a natural extension of the home.Upstairs, five generous bedrooms provide excellent accommodation for family life, including a luxurious principal suite with dual dressing rooms, a magnificent master bedroom, and a beautifully appointed ensuite. A separate guest annex, directly adjoining the main house, offers outstanding flexibility—perfect for extended family, visitors, or independent living—while remaining connected to the main residence.The gardens are a defining feature of Hazeldene. Wonderfully mature and exceptionally private, they have been thoughtfully designed to be enjoyed throughout the day, with multiple natural stone patios positioned to capture sunlight from morning to evening. Expansive lawns are framed by specimen trees, flowering shrubs, and established hedging, creating a dynamic, tranquil landscape ideal for family life, entertaining, or simply relaxing in complete privacy.Despite its tranquil, almost country-like atmosphere, Hazeldene is superbly located just minutes from the N11 and M50, with excellent transport links including DART, Luas, and bus routes nearby. The coastal villages of Killiney, Dalkey, Sandycove, and Dun Laoghaire offer cafés, restaurants, shops, and leisure amenities, while the Dublin Mountains are also within easy reach. A selection of highly regarded schools further enhances its appeal as an ideal family home.Hazeldene is a property of real substance and character, where generous accommodation meets outstanding gardens in a truly special setting. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that it has to offer.

Reception hall - 
A stunning double-height reception hall sets the tone for this exceptional home, with tall windows framing views of both the front and rear gardens. Double doors lead into a graceful hallway, finished in travertine natural stone flooring that extends throughout the ground floor.Full underfloor heating and complete insulation throughout the whole house create a naturally comfortable environment, warm in winter and cool in summer. This special environment begins at the front door and runs throughout the house. Ceilings are finished with elegant coving and integrated lighting, adding a refined and welcoming atmosphere.

Guest Cloakroom & WC's - 
Immediately off the entrance hall is a spacious cloakroom with ample storage, leading to a stylish guest WC featuring a bespoke vanity unit, large mirror, and contemporary fittings.At the far end of the hallway, a second WC and under-stair storage provide additional convenience. A separate door leads to the communications room, while an external door opens onto the rear garden and patio, allowing natural light to fill the space.

Dining room - 
A beautifully proportioned formal dining room with a bay window overlooking the gardens. Hardwood teak flooring, ceiling coving, feature lighting, underfloor heating, and integrated speakers create an elegant setting for both intimate dinners and large gatherings, comfortably seating up to 14 guests at a round table.

Drawing Room - 
A sophisticated and light-filled drawing room, featuring rich timber floors and expansive floor-to-ceiling glazing. Double doors open onto a private stone terrace and gardens beyond, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living.An Adams-style marble fireplace provides a classic focal point, while discreetly integrated lighting and ceiling speakers—operable via the home's smart system—enhance both atmosphere and comfort.

Kitchen / Breakfast room - 
The heart of the home is a spectacular open-plan kitchen, designed for modern living and effortless entertaining. Bespoke cabinetry, twin islands, and a striking octagonal atrium create a bright, welcoming space filled with natural light.Travertine flooring with underfloor heating adds warmth, while full-width bifold doors open to a sunlit patio and garden, perfect for al fresco dining.High-end appliances include twin Siemens ovens, gas and induction hobs with extractor, a built-in coffee machine, Neff microwave, twin Fisher & Paykel dishwashers, a full-sized fridge and under-counter fridge, and a wine fridge. A large central island provides ample workspace and storage.The integrated smart home system allows intuitive control of music, audio, and media, enhancing the kitchen as both a social and functional hub.

Utility Room - 
Practical and stylish, with travertine flooring, extensive wall and floor cabinetry, a circular stainless steel sink, space for a full-size freezer, and plumbing for a washing machine and dryer.

Family room - 
A warm and inviting family space with hardwood flooring and double doors opening directly onto the rear gardens. Features include bespoke cabinetry, a fitted bar, and a media unit, offering storage and display options.Integrated audio via the smart system allows the room's atmosphere to be tailored effortlessly, whether for entertaining or quiet family evenings.

TV Room - 
A cosy and intimate retreat, the TV room overlooks the gardens and patio. Featuring a marble fireplace, hardwood floors, surround sound, and soft ambient lighting, it is ideal for private relaxation. Fully connected to the smart home system, it offers seamless entertainment at the touch of a button.

Smart Home System - 
Hazeldene benefits from a fully integrated Control4 smart home system, operating throughout the house, particularly across the principal ground-floor rooms. It enables effortless control of audio, television, and security, with music, radio, and media easily accessible across all living spaces.Televisions and other systems are controllable via a central monitor in the communications ( comms) room or through the Control4 app, available on any smart phone. Security features include front gate monitoring and a comprehensive network of external cameras, night and day security alarm providing both convenience and peace of mind.

First Floor - 
A beautiful mahogany staircase with carpet runner and original stained glass window leads to a spacious landing, complete with attic access and a walk-in hot press for abundant storage.

Principal bedroom suite - 
A luxurious principal suite with a bay window framing views of the gardens and distant hills. The suite features a spacious dressing room with extensive wardrobe space and a central island with dressing table, complemented by a second dressing area for additional storage.The ensuite bathroom offers a walk-in shower, Jacuzzi bath, twin basins with storage, separate WC, and elegant tiling. Semi-circular glazing fills the space with natural light, while integrated ceiling speakers and lighting ensure comfort and convenience.

Guest Bedroom suite - 
A generously proportioned dual-aspect bedroom with garden views. The ensuite bathroom is finished in natural stone and includes both a bath and a separate shower, creating a welcoming retreat for visitors.

Bedrooms Three & Four - 
Two elegant double bedrooms, both overlooking the gardens and finished with soft lighting and decorative coving.

Family Bathroom - 
A stylish, well-appointed bathroom with bath, separate shower, modern WC, bidet, and wall-mounted basin, conveniently located to serve the additional bedrooms. A Velux window provides natural light.

Bedroom Five - 
A bright double bedroom with dual aspect and double doors opening onto a large roof terrace, ideal for enjoying morning sun or evening views.

Shower room - 
Located adjacent to Bedroom Five, this modern shower room features natural stone flooring and contemporary fittings.

Attic Storage - 
There is approximately 20 Sq.m of storage which is positioned above the main house. This storage is accessed via pull down stairs and is floored and separated in to two storage rooms.

Guest Annex - 
The guest annex provides versatile accommodation, accessible both internally from the kitchen and via its own private entrance. It includes:Ground Floor: Open-plan kitchen, dining, and living space with vaulted ceiling, travertine flooring, and fully fitted kitchen appliances. Double doors open onto the garden, and a rear lobby provides direct patio access. A ground-floor bedroom and shower room complete the level.First Floor: A further bedroom suite with walk-in dressing room, ensuite bathroom with Jacuzzi bath and shower, and double doors opening onto a private roof terrace.

Outside - 
Set within approximately one acre of beautifully landscaped gardens, Hazeldene enjoys complete privacy. Electric gates open onto a winding driveway bordered by mature trees, hedging, and feature lighting.Natural stone patios are positioned to capture sunlight throughout the day, with the main terrace off the kitchen providing a perfect setting for outdoor dining and entertaining.Additional amenities include multiple outdoor power points, extensive lighting, an electric car charging point, and two large Barna-style storage sheds. The gardens themselves feature expansive lawns, well-stocked borders, flowering plants, shrubs, and specimen trees, creating a serene and private setting.

• ADDITIONAL FEATURES
  • Kingspan Biocycle System
  • Hazeldene has a modern Kingspan biocycle system for the management of waste and wastewater, which was newly installed in 2009, and is subject to regular recorded maintenance by Kingspan and regular cleaning.
  • Rainwater harvesting system
  • Hazeldene has a Kingspan rainwater harvesting system. This system gathers water from all the roofs into a separate rainwater harvesting tank located in the lower garden.
  • Solar panels
  • Hazeldene has a small evacuated-flask solar panel system, which assists in heating water in the boiler house. These solar panels are out of sight as they are located on the annex roof.
  • Geothermal wells
  • Hazeldene has three geothermal wells located in the lower garden, which assist in harvesting heat from the ground and assist with the heat pump located in the boiler house. These wells were installed in 2009 when Hazeldene was completely rebuilt.
  • Insulation systems
  • Baker insulation systems are used throughout the house to ensure the house is fully insulated and is a vital contributory component in its A-rated energy status.
  • Windows
  • In addition to being double-glazed, all windows are specially treated to assist in the prevention of glare on artwork.
